first_48h_maintainer_outcome.body: Hi! I’d like to work on this. My plan is to narrow DAG.test() serialization to the tested DAG and resolvable trigger targets while preserving the behavior added for #64884, with coverage ensuring unrelated sibling DAGs are not rewritten. If that direction looks right, could you assign this issue to me?
